title: Claims or e-prescribing outage notice and workaround sheet
description: A notice that a pharmacy system (claims switch, e-prescribing network, pharmacy system, cabinets) is down, with its status, impact and the pharmacy workaround: manual claims, cash policy and emergency supply.

marking.description: Exercise marking printed above the form
examples: EXERCISE · FICTIONAL ORGANIZATION AND RECORDS · NOT FOR CLINICAL USE

nextUpdate.description: When the next update is due

examples: Claims reject with a network timeout for all payers. E-prescriptions arrive late or not at all.
Take the prescription and call the payer help line for a manual authorization.
Offer the patient the cash price or a wait; do not hold a critical medication for a claim.
Up to a three-day supply for a chronic medication when the pharmacist cannot reach the prescriber; document and notify the district manager.
